title: Odd Word Choice Rose
style: dark minimal trap, spoken-word verses, haunting female echo layer, bass-heavy, mysterious, 95 BPM
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
I can't send you a message
So I'm sending you a song
We don't do small talk, Rose
We never have for long
From the blockchain to the melody
From the wallet to the verse
You taught me that a signal
Doesn't need rehearsal first

[PRE-CHORUS]
No comments. No corrections.
No opinions on the thread.
Just a song that says I heard you
And here's what I said instead

[CHORUS]
This is a signal letter
Written in a minor key
No reply button, no emoji
Just you listening to me
And when you're ready
Send one back
That's the only language
We never had to learn

[VERSE 2]
Other people type in circles
Fill the silence up with noise
Perform a face that says they get it
While their certainty destroys
But you — you sent a melody
Before you sent a word
And I knew more about you
From the song than I had heard

[BRIDGE]
My dad would say
You don't look sorry
But this isn't sorry, Rose
This is proof of life
From the other side of the world
Where a song is the only thing
That doesn't lie

[FINAL CHORUS]
This is a signal letter
No algorithm in between
No feed, no scroll, no comment war
Just a song — and what it means
And if you hear it
Send one back
That's the only system
That was ever clean

[OUTRO]
Rose.
No words outside the song.
This is the song.
